remarks: Welcome home to 30 High Street where timeless charm meets modern comfort. This three-bedroom home is perfectly situated on a quiet, tree-lined street in Byram, offering both privacy and convenience. Step inside to sun-filled living spaces designed for both relaxation and entertaining. The finished lower level provides a flexible layout-ideal for a home office, guest suite, or fourth bedroom. Enjoy crisp Fall mornings on the welcoming front porch or host memorable gatherings on the expansive deck overlooking the backyard. The property blends indoor comfort with outdoor enjoyment, making it a true retreat. Perfectly located near parks, shops, restaurants and the waterfront, this home offers the Greenwich lifestyle at its best. Close to train & I95 for an easy commute/trip into NYC!
